description: Fetch a single campaign by its ID, including its objective, status, budget, and targeting. Monetary values are expressed in micros: 1,000,000 micros = 1 unit of the account's currency (for example, $1.00 = 1,000,000 micros). Divide any *_micros value by 1,000,000 to show a human-readable amount, and multiply by 1,000,000 to convert a currency amount into micros.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to fetch.

name: get_campaign
title: Get campaign
